styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating full-bleed deep-green gradient bands #2E6B4E and clean white or light-grey panels #FFFFFF/#F3F4F2; floor ledges trimmed by a thin warm metal line; a fabric drape prop in muted brick #A0524D appears only in hero set dressing
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio key from the front-left with gentle fill and a subtle rim, soft contact shadows under every product, no harsh specular hotspots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless color bands, light stone-like floor ledge, matte white card surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for short Chinese headlines with clean English micro-labels; short headlines only, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white icons on rounded-corner green gradient tiles; single stroke weight, minimal
styleLock.presentationRules: product reads as a pair of compact bean-shaped true-wireless earbuds with a small oval charging case; stable centered placement, consistent scale within each shot, soft grounding contact shadow, hovering renders must keep a soft drop shadow connecting to the surface below
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool premium tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep green #2E6B4E, pure white #FFFFFF, light grey #F3F4F2, charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one fresh green accent #4FA97F, with a muted brick #A0524D fabric prop allowed only in hero set dressing; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines with clean English micro-labels; alternating full-bleed green gradient bands and clean white or light-grey panels; bright soft diffused studio lighting from the front-left with a subtle rim and soft contact shadows; consistent thin-line white icons on rounded-corner green gradient tiles; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为详情页长图切片 9 片（60px 重叠），相邻重复画面合并为 8 个分镜。已剥离：模板水印与品牌字（千图科技 / QIANTU CHUPIN / MUSIC ERJI）、会员促销贴纸与二维码、参数表噪声值（型号 PM003、电池重量 1322G 等模板填充内容）；全部规格数值（单元尺寸、防水等级、蓝牙版本、整机重量与高度、电池容量、续航时长等）一律转为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽由使用方填写，未写入模版。源图混拼了两款耳机渲染：单耳挂耳式耳机（第 1/3/4 片）与豆式真无线+充电仓（第 1/5/7 片）；按文案（双耳同步传输/无线充电/24h 续航/53g 整机）与首屏主体占比判定主产品为豆式真无线蓝牙耳机（无线充电仓+主动降噪），挂耳式渲染已按版式语法改写为单耳悬停镜。L1=手机数码、L2=耳机音频 按图判定，与源夹名「数码」一致。与库内 13 款耳机模版区分：以「无线充电仓+主动降噪+13MM 大单元」卖点组合及深绿布艺影调区分，未撞型。
